build_checkpoint_writer: build a PyTorch distributed checkpoint writer using FsspecWriter to save tensors to a directory
create_checkpoint_reader: create a PyTorch distributed checkpoint reader using FsspecReader to restore tensors from a checkpoint directory
test_fsspec_writer_single_file: test the FsspecWriter with single_file_per_rank=True to write all tensors per rank into a single file
refactor_fsspec_reader_metadata: refactor the FsspecReader to read checkpoint metadata and set up storage data from a .metadata file
summarize_split_by_size: summarize the _split_by_size_and_type function that balances write items across buckets by size and type
